maintenance_led.reason: Avista Utilities sells regulated electricity and natural gas to households and businesses; consumed energy, not repair or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from retail electric and natural gas customers (households, businesses) billed under regulated rates, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through regulated utility rate base investment in Washington, Idaho, Oregon; only occasional acquisitions, such as Alaska Electric Light and Power.

mission_critical.reason: Regulated monopoly electric and natural gas utility; customers in its service territory cannot practically switch suppliers.
